name: vk-time
description: VK TIME — Luxury International Wristwatch E-Commerce Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run seo && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run seo && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api
scripts.test: npx tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts && npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test --workspace=apps/api
